corrections.why: The Forest Lookouts page shows a single letter S below the county line and names no agency.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Mapcarta and the Forest Lookouts page both put the tower in Choctaw County. Mapcarta places the community of the same name in Pushmataha County, so the name is shared by two places.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Forest Lookouts gives only name and county. The brief's agency value S is not an agency name: the page shows a bare letter S below the county line, unexplained, so removal is proposed. Mapcarta is map-derived and places the tower in Choctaw County and a community named Sobol in Pushmataha County; the community is not the tower. The Oklahoman article and a Forest Heritage Center Facebook post were unreadable. No build, staffing, fire or condition source was found. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 4 page reads. Story is 108 words, below the 120 minimum, because no further evidence was found.
